assets.proceduralFallback: Codex entry uses the procedural hostile-red circle glyph until a bespoke icon lands.
Tarnished uses the procedural corroded verdigris ring indicator (tarnished-indicator phase).
No authored cast animation required for this slice; the cast-start-cue phase reads without one.
Telegraph uses the procedural locked hostile-red circle with runes and anticipation fill.
Resolution uses the procedural verdigris/bronze burst rings and particle sparks.
